scope.source: Official English Binance announcement pages/search text; one regional official result retained as unresolved
scope.focus: Flat ordinary Portfolio Margin collateral ratios, before and after
scope.excluded_queries: No price reaction, return, profitability, funding or market-price query performed

counting_rules: One canonical article ID is one notice batch, regardless of number of affected assets or ancillary PM Pro tiers.
Same-article amendments and locale duplicates are not additional events.
Absolute(after-before)>=10 percentage points is only a mathematical materiality flag; it does not prove native eligibility or strict qualification.
Publication and update displays are never substituted for historical first durable receipt.
One notice with both signs is marked MIXED; this does not establish two direction samples or how frozen capacity/selection would choose.
coverage_caveats: Bounded search results are not a complete 2026 archive or an unbiased sample; no zero-event claim for months/weeks absent from results.
Complete ordinary flat table in search text is weaker than successful current body retrieval and never authenticates the original historical revision.
Canonical English route is retained when directly returned in official search/body evidence; regional-only candidate is UNKNOWN.

Historical first receipt, authoritative asset mapping and native Hyperliquid ordinary eligibility are UNKNOWN for every row; strict qualifying-event frequency cannot be estimated from these notices alone.
Displayed publication/update times lack an explicit timezone in retrieved text; original display preserved, UTC normalization UNKNOWN. Effective rollout starts explicitly say UTC.
Current revised notices may not match the originally published plan. Sept25 explicitly discloses a plan modification; original body/version was not recovered.
The 2026-10-23 batch was announced on Oct20 but was future at cutoff; do not add it to occurred historical frequency.
All prerelease/pre-T0 notices are excluded from prospective outcome scoring under the frozen protocol.
